config.title: Orka
config.provider: Provider of the main agent: claude, openai, gemini, claude-code, or custom:<id> for a provider added in Settings > Providers.
config.claude.model: Claude model version, e.g. claude-opus-5-5 (Opus 5.5), claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-4-5. Pick it in Settings > Providers to see every version.
config.claude.effort: Claude effort level: how much the model thinks per turn (trades quality against latency and cost).
config.claude.refusalFallback: If a Claude safety classifier declines a request, let the API retry it on Anthropic's recommended fallback model instead of stopping (server-side fallbacks, beta).
config.openai.model: OpenAI model version, e.g. gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra (or any model ID served by the configured base URL).
config.openai.baseUrl: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API (e.g. OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1).
config.openai.reasoningEffort: Optional reasoning_effort for OpenAI reasoning models. Empty = model default.
config.gemini.model: Gemini model version, e.g. gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.1-pro-preview.
config.gemini.thinkingLevel: Optional thinking level for Gemini. Empty = model default.
config.claudeCode.enabled: Offer the locally installed Claude Code CLI as a provider. It runs on your own Claude Code login. **Unofficial**: Orka is not affiliated with Anthropic; make sure your use follows Anthropic's terms. For teams and products, use a Claude API key.
config.claudeCode.model: Model for the local Claude Code CLI: an alias (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable), a full model ID, or 'default' for the CLI's own default.
config.claudeCode.effort: Effort level passed to Claude Code (--effort). Empty = CLI default.
config.claudeCode.path: Path to the claude executable. Empty = auto-detect (npm global install, ~/.local/bin, PATH).
config.customProviders: Extra OpenAI-compatible providers (OpenRouter, DeepSeek, xAI, Mistral, Groq, Together, Ollama, LM Studio, or any other endpoint). Easiest to manage from Settings > Providers in the chat view. API keys are kept in secret storage, not here.
config.subagents.enabled: Let the main agent delegate to sub-agents (explore, review, worker).
config.subagents.maxParallel: How many read-only sub-agents (explore, review) may run at the same time. Workers that edit files always run one at a time. 1 = no parallelism.
config.subagents.agents: Provider and model per sub-agent. Easiest to change from the Agents panel in the chat view.
config.subagents.agents.provider: 'inherit' = same provider and model as the main agent; or a provider id such as gemini or custom:openrouter.
config.subagents.agents.model: Model ID; empty = the provider's default model.
config.supervisor.enabled: Let a supervisor model watch the main agent and correct it when it goes the wrong way. Its corrections are shown in the chat.
config.supervisor.provider: Supervisor provider. 'inherit' = same as the main agent.
config.supervisor.model: Supervisor model ID; empty = the provider's default model.
config.supervisor.frequency: When the supervisor looks at the main agent's work. It never does the work itself; it warns the agent when something is logically wrong or does not match what you asked.
config.supervisor.frequency.enum.0: Smart (recommended, fewest tokens): checks the plan, steps in when the agent is stuck or asks for help, and reviews the final result - from a short summary instead of the whole conversation.
config.supervisor.frequency.enum.1: Review every step that edits files, runs commands or changes the plan (thorough, uses more tokens).
config.supervisor.frequency.enum.2: Review every step of the main agent (most thorough, most tokens).
config.hooks: Commands Orka runs around the agent's work. `afterEdit`: after each file an agent edits (formatters, linters; `{file}` is the edited file, `match` limits it to globs such as `*.ts`); the output goes back to the agent. `beforeFinish`: before the agent finishes a request that changed code (lint, type-check, tests); failures send it back to fix them. Example: `{"afterEdit": [{"command": "npx prettier --write {file}", "match": "*.{ts,tsx}"}], "beforeFinish": [{"command": "npm test"}]}`. Hooks from a folder's own settings run only after you allow them.
config.hooks.afterEdit: Commands run after an agent edits a matching file. {file} is replaced with the file's path.
config.hooks.beforeFinish: Commands run before the agent finishes a request that changed code. A failure sends the agent back to fix it.
config.permissionMode: How much freedom the agent has.
config.permissionMode.enum.0: Ask before every file change, command and plan.
config.permissionMode.enum.1: Edit files automatically; ask for risky commands, deletes and git writes.
config.permissionMode.enum.2: Work on its own; only destructive actions still ask.
config.permissions.fileEdit: Override for file create/edit. 'mode' = follow the permission mode.
config.permissions.git: Override for git commands that change history or remotes (commit, push, reset...).
config.autoVerify: When the agent changed files but never ran a build/test afterwards, ask it to verify before finishing.
config.maxIterations: Maximum model turns per request before the agent pauses.
config.commandTimeoutSeconds: Default timeout for terminal commands run by the agent.
config.shell: Shell used for agent commands. Empty = PowerShell on Windows, $SHELL or /bin/bash elsewhere.
config.customInstructions: Extra instructions appended to the agent's system prompt.
config.compaction.auto: When a request grows past the threshold, replace the conversation with a handoff note (model summary + the orchestrator's own record of plan, changed files, requests and supervisor corrections).
config.compaction.thresholdTokens: Prompt size (tokens) that triggers automatic compaction.
config.language.enum.0: Follow the machine: VS Code's display language, otherwise the operating system's language.
config.tokenBudget: Pause a request once it has used this many new tokens across all agents (input + output + cache writes; cache reads are not counted). 0 = no limit.
config.supervisor.mode: How supervisor reviews interact with the main agent.
config.supervisor.mode.enum.0: The agent keeps working while a step is reviewed; a correction arrives with its next step (faster).
config.supervisor.mode.enum.1: The agent waits for each review before continuing; corrections land one step earlier (slower).
config.pricing: Your own prices in USD per million tokens, keyed "provider/model" (* wildcards allowed), e.g. {"openai/gpt-6-*": {"input": 3, "output": 12}}. Used for the cost estimates in the Usage panel; they take precedence over the built-in Claude API prices.
config.skills.enabled: Offer skills (expert playbooks such as unity, debugging, testing) to the agents. Skills are global: built in, plus your own in ~/.orka/skills.
config.skills.disabled: Skills the agents are not offered (by name).
config.permissions.network: Override for web access (reading web pages, opening external sites). 'mode' = follow the permission mode: Ask asks, Balanced and Autonomous allow.
config.claudeCode.autoUpdate: Keep the Claude Code CLI up to date: run 'claude update' once a day in the background, and right away when a chosen model needs a newer version. Model lists of all providers are refreshed daily either way.
config.supervisor.frequency.enum.3: Only review when the agent says it is done.
config.fallback.provider: Where the main agent continues when its provider hits a usage or rate limit, or cannot be reached (e.g. the Claude Code session limit): a provider id, or 'inherit' for off. The rest of that request runs on it.
config.fallback.model: Fallback model; empty = that provider's default model.
command.importMcpFromClaude: Import MCP Servers from Claude Code
config.mcp.enabled: Give the agents the tools of the configured MCP servers (Unity Editor, Blender, databases, ...).
config.mcpServers: MCP servers by name. Each is either {"command": "...", "args": [...], "env": {...}} (a local program speaking stdio) or {"url": "http://localhost:8080/mcp"} (Streamable HTTP). A .mcp.json in the workspace is used too, after you allow it.
config.mcpServers.command: Program to start, e.g. npx, uvx or a full path.
config.mcpServers.url: URL of a Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint.
config.trackCommandChanges: Snapshot the workspace around the agent's terminal commands, so files they change (npm install, generators, formatters) show up in the Changes list and can be reverted. Uses a private git directory in the extension's storage; your own repository is never touched.
config.inlineReview: Highlight the lines the agent changed in the editor, with Keep / Revert code lenses above each change.
config.routing.provider: A lighter, cheaper model for short questions about the project ("what does X do?"); requests that need changes stay on the main model, and if the light model tries to change something the main model takes over. A provider id, or 'inherit' for off.
config.routing.model: Model for simple questions; empty = that provider's default model.
config.browser.path: Chrome, Edge or Chromium executable the agent's browser tool uses to look at pages (headless). Empty = auto-detect the installed browser.
config.memory.learn: After a task that changed code, ask the agent for up to 3 lasting lessons about the project (working commands, pitfalls, conventions) and add the new ones to .project-ai/lessons.md. Only in folders that have a .project-ai/ folder (Orka: Initialize Project Memory).
